CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[AzureSQLMaintenance] @Operation NVARCHAR(30) ='reindex' ,@From INT = 30 ,@To INT = 100 ,@MinNumberOfPages = 10 AS
DECLARE @SQLString NVARCHAR(4000), @Schema NVARCHAR(40), @Table NVARCHAR(100), @Index NVARCHAR(100);
IF(@Operation = 'reindex') BEGIN DECLARE TableIndexCursor CURSOR FOR
SELECT dbschemas.[name] as 'Schema' ,dbtables.[name] as 'Table' , dbindexes.[name] AS 'Index' FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats (DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) AS indexstats INNER JOIN sys.tables dbtables on dbtables.[object_id] = indexstats.[object_id] INNER JOIN sys.schemas dbschemas on dbtables.[schema_id] = dbschemas.[schema_id] INNER JOIN sys.indexes AS dbindexes ON dbindexes.[object_id] = indexstats.[object_id] AND indexstats.index_id = dbindexes.index_id WHERE indexstats.database_id = DB_ID() AND dbindexes.[name] IS NOT NULL AND indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent BETWEEN @From AND @To AND indexstats.page_count > @MinNumberOfPages ORDER BY indexstats.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC
OPEN TableIndexCursor FETCH NEXT FROM TableIndexCursor INTO @Schema, @Table, @Index WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
--SET @SQLString = 'ALTER INDEX ALL ON [' + @Schema + '].[' + @Table + '] REBUILD with (online=ON)'; SET @SQLString = 'ALTER INDEX [' + @Index + '] ON [' + @Schema + '].[' + @Table + '] REBUILD with (online=ON)'; SELECT @SQLString AS Cmd_Run; EXECUTE sp_executesql @SQLString; FETCH NEXT FROM TableIndexCursor INTO @Schema, @Table, @Index END
CLOSE TableIndexCursor DEALLOCATE TableIndexCursor
END
